lines.text: Israel is told to return to the LORD and bring their confessions, because they stumbled by their iniquity.
Israel says Egypt will not save them, and they will never again call their handiwork their gods.
The LORD says He will heal their apostasy and freely love them, because His anger has turned away.
The LORD will be like dew to Israel, and those dwelling in his shade will grow thorns.
The LORD tells Ephraim that his fruit comes from Him, and the righteous walk in the LORD's right ways.
